svg.title: Orange Curve I
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Third painting from left in the explicitly captioned 1982 studio photograph. Broad curved top and downward apex. No dimensions reported; normalized approximate study.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=68; record guggenheim1996-essay-68-fig-2c; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
